paite: Huan Rehoboam Shekem ah ahoh hi. Israel tengteng Shekem ah kumpipa a amah bawl ding in ahoh khinta uhi.
heading: Mallam Namte Helna / (2 Kro 10.1-19)

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam in huai thu ana zak in Kumpipa Solomon kiang a pan ataimangna Aigupta gam a om lai ahi a, Jeroboam ahihleh Aigupta gam a om ahi.
Amah ava samsak ua, Jeroboam leh Israel kikaikhawm tengteng ahong ua, Rehoboam kiang ah,
"Na pa'n ka hakkol uh agiksak mahmah hi. Huaiziak in na pa hon zat gimna leh ahakkol giktak ka tung ua angak hon hihzangsak inla, huchi in nang nna ka sem ding uh," chi in ahong gen uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Ni thum sung va kikhinkhe phot unla; ka kiang ah hong pai nawn un," achi hi. Huchi in mite apaikheta uh.
Kumpipa Rehoboam in apa Solomon dam lai a, akiang a om upate kiang ah, "Hiai mite bangchi in ka dawng dia hon hilh mah dih uh," chi in adong hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Tuni a hiai mite sikha a na om a, a-nna uh sem a, amau dawng a, akiang ua thuhoih na genleh, tangtawn in na sikha in a-om ding uh," achi uhi.
Himahleh upate hoihsak azui kei a, amah toh kivual tuailai akiang a omte adong zawta hi.
Akiang uah, "Hiai mite, ka kiang a, na pa'n ka tung ua hakkol angak hon hihzangsak in, chi a hong gen mite bangchi in ka dawng dia, hon hilh mah dih uh," achi hi.

Akhanvual tuailaite'n akiang ah, "Hiai mite, na pa'n ka hakkol uh agiksak thei mahmah a, nang hon hihzangsak dih ve, na kiang achi mite kiang ah, hichibang in chi inla, hichibang in akiang uah gen in.
'Ka pa kawng sang in ka khutme alianzaw. Ka pa'n hakkol giktak ahon na batsak a, ke'n na hakkol uh ka behlap lai ding hi. Ka pa'n zepna in ahon sawi a, ke'n aikam in ka hon sawi ding,' " achi hi.
Huchi in Jeroboam leh mi tengteng kumpipa'n ni thum nung chiang in, "Ka kiang ah hong nawn un," chi a ahilh bang in, ani thum ni in Rehoboam kiang ah ava hoh uhi.
Kumpipa'n mite khauhtak in ana dawng a, upate hoihsak apompih kei hi.
Tuailaite hoihsak bang in, "Ka pa'n na hakkol uh ana giksak a, ke'n na hakkol uh ka behlap lai dia, ka pa'n zepna in ahon na sawi a, ke'n ahihleh aikam in ka hon sawi ding," achi hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n mite thu angaikheta kei; hiai bang a thil om TOUPA a pan lah ahi ngal a. TOUPA'N Shiloh mi Ahijah zang a Nebat tapa Jeroboam kiang a, athugen atungtun theihna ding ahi.

Israel tengteng in kumpipa'n athugen uh apom kei chih atheih un, "David ah tantuan bang i nei ua? Jesse tapa ah gouluah ding i nei kei uh. Israelte aw, na puanin chiat uah pai un. David, na inkuan kingaihtuah in," chi in kumpipa adawng uh. Huchi in Israelte apuanin chiat uah apaita uhi.
Himahleh Judah khopite a teng Israel suante tung ah Rehoboam in vai ahawm hi.

Huchi in kumpipa Rehoboam in phutluih nasemte heutu Adoram asawl hi. Israel tengteng in suang in ana deng ua, asita hi. Huaiziak in Jerusalem a tai ding in kumpipa Rehoboam kintak in akangtalai ah atuang hi,
Huchi in tuni tan in David inkote tung ah Israelte ana hel uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israel tengteng in Jeroboam ahong kik nawn chih azak un, kikaihkhawmna a hoh ding in asamsak ua, Israelte tung ah kumpipa in abawl uhi. Judah nam chih louh David inkote zui kuamah a-om kei uh.
Jerusalem atuntak in Rehoboam in Israel inkote dou a Solomon tapa Rehoboam lalgam la nawn ding in Judah inkuan tengteng leh Benjamin nam a pan mihangsan atelkhiak, nuaikhat-le-singgiat akaikhawm hi.
heading: Shemaiah Thugenkholh / (2 Kro 11.1-4)

paite: Himahleh Pathian mipa Shemaiah kiang ah Pathian thu ahong tung hi.
Judah gam kumpipa Solomon tapa Rehoboam kiang ah leh Judah leh Benjamin inkuan tengteng kiang ah leh midang teng kiang ah,

TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Va hohtou kei un. Israel suan na unaute va dou kei un. Na inn chiat uah pai nawn vek un. Hiai kei thilhih ahi, chi in gen in," achi hi. Huchi in TOUPA thu azui ua, TOUPA thu bang in akik nawn ua, apai nawn vekta uhi.
Huchi in Jeroboam in Ephraim tanggam ah Shekem khua asat a, huai ah ateng hi. Huai a pan apawtkhia a, Penuel khua asat hi.
heading: Pathian A Pan Jeroboam Akiheimang

paite: Jeroboam in alungtang in, "Lalgam David inkote ahong hi nawn diam aw," achi hi.

"Hiai mite Jerusalem a TOUPA' inn a kithoihnate lan dia ahohtouh uleh alungtang un atoupa uh, Rehoboam, Judah gam kumpipa lam ah a-awn nawn mai ding. Huchi in kei ahon that ding ua, Judah gam kumpipa Rehoboam lam ah abelh nawn mai ding uh," achi hi.

Kumpipa'n mi adong a, dangka-eng in bawngnou lim nih abawl a; akiang uah, "Nou a ding in Jerusalem a hohtouh ahaksa lo tel hi. Aw, Israel en dih uh, Aigupta gam a pan nou hon pikhia na pathiante uh," achi hi.
Huchi in khat Bethel ah akoih a, khat pen Dan ah akoih hi.
Mipite lah hiai bawngnou lim khat be ding in Dan tanpha ava pai ziak un hiai khelhna ahong hita hi.
Mun sang ah innte alam a, Levi suante hilou, miniampente lak a mi siampu in abawl hi.

Jeroboam in Judah gam a ankuanglui aneih mah bang un akha giatna, huai kha ani sawm-le-nga ni ankuanglui ni ding in asep hi. Maitam ah ahohtou a; Bethel ah abawngnou lim kiang ah akithoih hi. Mun sang abawlte ah siampute sep in Bethel ah akoih hi.
heading: Bethel A Biakna Mohpaih Ahi

paite: Ama'n adeih bang a, aseh kha mah, akha giatna, ani sawm-le-nga ni in Bethel a maitam abawl ah ahohtou hi. Israel suante a ding in ankuangluina asep a, maitam a gimlim hal ding in ahohtou hi.
